issues.after: Uses existing createStoryChoiceChapter; source 2 creates 3A/3B immediately with unchanged linked asset/layout semantics.

issues.after: Destination uses cutLabel; navigation and counter use current chapter cuts; manuscript chapter dropdown uses chapterLabel.

issues.before: Current-cut connection context exposed incoming links only.
issues.after: Outgoing destinations, endings and pending/missing repair buttons are available next to incoming context.

issues.before: Runtime error details and audio exceptions appeared directly; edit exit disabled until runtime ready.

issues.before: 390x844 reading stacked menus/preview toolbar; viewport bottom extended to y1001.2 and clipped dialogue. Resize captures could acknowledge a prior viewport revision.
